text:
incident-bot: [P0] Alert — spike in TLS handshake failures from Cloudflare edges (525) affecting api.redwood-inference.com. Auto-page to oncall.

alex (oncall): ack here, looking. Paging SRE.

lina (support): multiple customer tickets incoming — errors since ~08:12 UTC, lots of 525 and some 524 timeouts. Example: customer request id req_9b3f -> 525 SSL handshake.

jen (sre): seeing the same on dashboards. Spike in edge TLS errors correlated with Cloudflare POPs in us-east and eu-west. Throughput to hosted API down ~30% and error rate up ~18%.

matt (eng-runtime): are origin servers healthy?

jen (sre): origin healthy, requests make it to our ALB when we bypass CF. Cloudflare logs show handshake failures pre-origin.

matt (eng-runtime): can we fail traffic to direct origin (bypass Cloudflare) while CF investigates?

oliver (product): customer-impact note for comms: list affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat, embeddings. Add note about degraded streaming.

alex (oncall): plan: 1) short-term: route critical customers to direct origin by changing api DNS records (low TTL) + add bypass route for dedicated tenants. 2) mid-term: Cloudflare route fallback to another POP via MW config. 3) engage CF support with packet captures.

jen (sre): starting diagnostics: 
```
# quick probe
curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.com/health
* Connected to api.redwood-inference.com (104.18.123.45) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake: SSL_connect: SSLERROR: s:
* schannel: next InitializeSecurityContext failed: Unknown error
* Closing connection 0
curl: (35) SSL connect error
```

jen (sre): dig shows some requests resolving to Cloudflare anycast IPs, some to older origin A records depending on resolver. DNS responses look fine but CF edge TLS fails.

matt (eng-runtime): prepping DNS swap: I'll lower TTL to 30s and push A records pointing to lb-internal.redwood.prod (private IPs via Route53 alias). Can we open emergency access on ALB for public?

alex (oncall): authorize. lina, please prepare customer comms draft about degraded API and mitigation.

lina (support): working on draft. Will post to status page and customer channel.

cloudflare-status-bot: Cloudflare status: Investigating — We are investigating issues that may affect TLS handshakes in multiple locations. https://cloudflarestatus.com/inc/abcd1234

matt (eng-runtime): applied TTL change, updated A records to direct origin for a small subset (10% traffic) via weighted DNS. Monitoring now.

jen (sre): Canary traffic shows origin accepts connections and requests succeed with normal latency. Error rate on that cohort drops to baseline.

oliver (product): good. prioritize critical customers for direct routing first.

lina (support): posted public status: "Partial outage affecting API reachability due to third-party CDN TLS issues. We're routing critical traffic directly to our origin while Cloudflare investigates."

alex (oncall): handoff: I'm going offline in 30m, @jen take incident lead after that.

jen (sre): taking lead. I'll continue liaising with Cloudflare.

cloudflare-status-bot: Update — Identified: An internal configuration rollout caused an edge TLS handshake regression in a subset of POPs. Working on a rollback.

matt (eng-runtime): CF says rollback in progress. continuing DNS failover until CF confirms.

jen (sre): observed rollback effect at 08:42 UTC — error rate trending down.

lina (support): customer updates: 95% of affected customers see restored service; a handful still routed through problematic POPs.

alex (oncall): reassigning post-incident tasks: - Root cause analysis (CF interactions): jen - DNS failover timeline and runbook updates: matt - Customer communications recap: lina - Postmortem author: oliver.

jen (sre): Status: Cloudflare reports Full Service Restored at 08:56 UTC. We'll keep direct routing for 15 more minutes then revert DNS weights back.

matt (eng-runtime): reverted DNS weights at 09:12 UTC, TTL back to 300s after stabilization checks.

lina (support): final update posted to status page and customer channels.

oliver (product): incident severity P1 -> downgraded to P0 resolved; assigning postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident resolved — 2h incident duration. Please fill out postmortem template: /ops/postmortems/new.

jen (sre): adding follow-ups: validate fallback playbook, add synthetic tests for TLS handshake failures, ensure we have secondary CDN vendor in procurement pipeline.

alex (oncall): thanks team. closing incident handoff to postmortem owners. :checkered_flag:
